preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setFees function
Attacker must hold some CRACE tokens to trigger fee collection

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call setFees() with extremely high fee percentages (e.g., 9900 for each fee component) and a low feeDenominator (e.g., 10000). Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection, causing most of the transferred amount to be taken as fees and accumulated in the contract. Finally, use authorized functions like manualSend() or rescueBNB() to drain the accumulated BNB from the contract to the attacker's address.
